routes.summary: Swap the API token: the old one stops working at once; the new one is in api-token

Resumes a paused Actor by the policy of the cause; idempotent by Idempotency-Key
The spending caps (per profile and per Executor) with what each has spent

The effective configuration, with every value that could be a secret held back
Edits keys of the configuration file with the validation of a start; applies on restart
Answers a pending decision of the Producer; idempotent by Idempotency-Key
Event stream with resume by Last-Event-ID: history after the cursor, then live
Executors of the configuration and of the table, by id, by cursor
Ideas in the order they arrived, by cursor; filter by state, scenario, play and group
One idea
Sets an idea aside for later, with the reason
Drops an idea for good, with the reason
Puts a deferred idea back in the queue
Layout preferences of an interface (the default when none was saved)
Replaces the layout preferences of an interface
Orders (in force, scheduled, ended) in the order they were given, by cursor
Gives an order (an instruction, a rule or a suspension); idempotent by Idempotency-Key
One order
Changes the validity of an order (`for` counts from the current end)
Revokes an order, with the reason
Suspends a global order in one scenario by giving a local suspension order
One play with its stages and demands
The latest version of each key of the blackboard of a play, by key, by cursor
One key of the blackboard of a play: the latest version, or the one asked for

Resumes a paused play; idempotent by Idempotency-Key

One account with its quota state
Stops giving new sessions to an account and waits for the running ones
The ordered Executor list of each role, with the next Executor and the exhaustion rule
Scenarios (projects, tasks, chats), oldest first, by cursor; filter by kind and state
Opens a scenario (a project or a chat) and its Director; idempotent by Idempotency-Key
WebSocket of the chat with the Director; authenticated by a ticket, not by the token
One scenario with its repositories, overrides and counts of open plays and decisions
Attachments of a scenario (metadata only), in the order they came, by cursor
Attaches a file of the daemon machine or a pasted text to a scenario; idempotent
Metadata of one attachment
The content of one attachment: text, or base64 for an image or a binary file

Consumption totals, optionally split by session, play, profile or Executor
